cards.meaning: countermeasure; remedy applied against a specific threat
cards.example: Kailangan ng pangontra ang Bangko Sentral sa pagbaba ng piso.
cards.exampleMeaning: The central bank needs a countermeasure against the peso's slide.
cards.note: Aktibong hakbang laban sa tiyak na banta; iba sa 'pananggalang' (kalasag, pasibo) at 'hakbang' (anumang hakbang). Pormal sa ulat; may kahulugan ding anting-anting sa popular na gamit.
cards.tiesTo: Peso breaks P63 / BSP pressure to intervene

cards.meaning: formal filing of a charge; bringing an accusation to court
cards.example: Tuloy ang pagsasakdal sa mga opisyal na sangkot sa flood control.
cards.exampleMeaning: The filing of charges against officials involved in flood control continues.
cards.note: Mula sa ugat na 'sakdal'. Mas pormal kaysa 'pagsasampa' (pangkalahatang paghahain ng kaso) at 'paghahabla' (demanda ng pribadong tao).

cards.example: 需求回升，企业才能转嫁成本；反之，利润还会继续被挤压。
cards.examplePinyin: Xūqiú huíshēng, qǐyè cáinéng zhuǎnjià chéngběn; fǎnzhī, lìrùn hái huì jìxù bèi jǐyā.
cards.exampleMeaning: If demand recovers, firms can pass costs on; conversely, profits will keep getting squeezed.
cards.note: 书面语/formal; spoken equivalent 要不然/不然. Logical flip of an if-then. Contrast 相反 (contrasts with an existing fact) and 否则 (otherwise + bad consequence).

cards.meaning: with the result that; so that (usually an undesirable outcome)
cards.example: 成本不断上涨，以致下游企业的利润越来越薄。
cards.examplePinyin: Chéngběn bùduàn shàngzhǎng, yǐzhì xiàyóu qǐyè de lìrùn yuèláiyuè báo.
cards.exampleMeaning: Costs keep rising, with the result that downstream firms' profits get thinner and thinner.
cards.note: 书面语/formal connective between 2 clauses; leans negative. Contrast 导致 (verb, takes a noun object) and 因而 (neutral result).
